name: knty-ceo
description: KNTY CEO: the company control center. Windows desktop app for executives, admins and heads of department, with a Node.js + PostgreSQL server that connects to the HR system and Predicto.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ceo/shared && npm run build -w @ceo/server && npm run build -w @ceo/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ceo/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ceo/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
